Specification: This module specifies an abstract distributed replicated log system in which each server maintains a local committed log and can either copy entries from a longer log or extend its own log. The model assumes a strong shared-state style fault-free view in which a server can directly inspect the logs of all other servers, rather than communicating through messages; comments note that this is unrealistic for real distributed systems and contrast it with protocols such as Raft. The specification enforces a machine-closed fairness condition requiring weak fairness for both copying and extending at every server, proves an invariant bounding the lag between server logs, proves that every server keeps extending forever, and also defines a stronger synchronization property that is intentionally not guaranteed.
